statement: ∀ c < 1, sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 = sphere ∩ {p | c < p 2} ∧ northPole ∈ sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1
script:
# name: set-height-cap-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Maps.height_cap
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : c < 1), sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 = sphere ∩ {p | c < p 2} ∧ northPole ∈ sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 := by
  intro c hc
  constructor
  · ext p
    simp only [sphere, height, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, h1, -⟩; exact ⟨h, h1⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, h1⟩; exact ⟨h, h1, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p 0), sq_nonneg (p 1)]⟩
  · simp [sphere, height, northPole, hc]
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['0', '(by norm_num)'], True, "have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : c < 1), sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 = sphere ∩ {p | c < p 2} ∧ northPole ∈ sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 := by
  intro c hc
  constructor
  · ext p
    simp only [sphere, height, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, h1, -⟩; exact ⟨h, h1⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, h1⟩; exact ⟨h, h1, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p 0), sq_nonneg (p 1)]⟩
  · simp [sphere, height, northPole, hc]
exact @key (0) ((by norm_num))"),
    (['-1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, "have key : ∀ (c : ℝ) (hc : c < 1), sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 = sphere ∩ {p | c < p 2} ∧ northPole ∈ sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 := by
  intro c hc
  constructor
  · ext p
    simp only [sphere, height, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, h1, -⟩; exact ⟨h, h1⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, h1⟩; exact ⟨h, h1, by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (p 0), sq_nonneg (p 1)]⟩
  · simp [sphere, height, northPole, hc]
exact @key (-1/2) ((by norm_num))"),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]

goal.text: sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1 = sphere ∩ {p | c < p 2} ∧ northPole ∈ sphere ∩ height ⁻¹' Set.Ioc c 1
